# External (free) art
Outside art Yan allowed on 2026-11-10 ("import everything that is safe for use now"). Only CC0 (public domain) assets are here. Every pack is listed in `SOURCES.md` with source, author and licence.

| Folder | Meaning |
|-|-|
| `to-use/` | Fits the game as it is (a crop of a pack, ready to cut sprites from). |
| `to-be-altered/` | Good material that needs recolouring, resizing (never stretch: redraw or recolour) or cutting up first. |
| `reference/` | Look at it, draw from it; not meant to ship as is. |

Free downloads from itch.io and OpenGameArt need those hosts on the cloud environment's allowlist. Anything that is not CC0 (e.g. the CC-BY Summer Trees, the 0_mem0ry furniture packs with their own terms) was NOT imported.
